DRead the text. Write T (True) or F (False).

Grandma’s Lentil Soup

My grandmother makes delicious lentil soup. First, she washes the lentils and puts them in a saucepan. Then, she chops an onion and a carrot and adds them to the lentils. After that, she pours water into the saucepan and boils everything for thirty minutes. Next, she mixes the soup with a blender until it is smooth. Finally, she adds a pinch of salt and serves it with lemon. It is healthy and nutritious!
  1. 1

    Grandmother washes the lentils first.

  2. 2

  3. 3

  4. 4

  5. 5

    She serves the soup with lemon.

  6. 6

    She adds a lot of salt.
